```python import pytest from youtube_dl.extractor.zdf import ZDFChannelIE, ZDFIE from youtube_dl.utils import InfoExtractor # Helper to create a minimal InfoExtractor subclass that records calls class DummyIE(InfoExtractor): def __init__(self): super().__init__() self.downloaded = [] def _download_webpage(self, url, video_id, note=None, errnote=None, headers=None, data=None, timeout=None, note_on_error=None, errnote_on_error=None, fatal=True, add_dlc=False): self.downloaded.append((url, video_id)) return self._webpage def _real_extract(self, url): return super()._real_extract(url) @pytest.fixture def dummy_ie(): return DummyIE() def test_real_extract_parses_plusbar_urls(dummy_ie): # Prepare a fake webpage containing two data-plusbar-url entries dummy_ie._webpage = '''
''' # Patch the IE key to avoid dependency on the real ZDFIE implementation dummy_ie.ie_key = lambda: 'ZDFIE' result = dummy_ie._real_extract('https://www.zdf.de/sport/das-aktuelle-sportstudio') # The playlist should contain two unique entries assert result['entries'] == [ {'url': 'https://www.zdf.de/video1.html', 'ie': 'ZDFIE'}, {'url': 'https://www.zdf.de/video2.html', 'ie': 'ZDFIE'} ] # The title should be extracted from og:title if present, otherwise None assert result['title'] is None def test_real_extract_no_plusbar_urls(dummy_ie): # Webpage with no data-plusbar-url attributes dummy_ie._webpage = 'No videos here' dummy_ie.ie_key = lambda: 'ZDFIE' result = dummy_ie._real_extract('https://www.zdf.de/filme/taunuskrimi/') # No entries should be returned assert result['entries'] == [] # Title extraction should not raise an error assert result['title'] is None def test_real_extract_invalid_url(dummy_ie): # The suitable method should return False for a URL that matches ZDFIE # We simulate this by monkeypatching ZDFIE.suitable to return True original_suitable = ZDFIE.suitable ZDFIE.suitable = staticmethod(lambda url: True) try: # Since ZDFChannelIE.suitable will delegate to ZDFIE.suitable and return False, # calling _real_extract should still work but we test that suitable logic is respected assert not ZDFChannelIE.suitable('https://www.zdf.de/sport/das-aktuelle-sportstudio') finally: ZDFIE.suitable = original_suitable ```
